views.name: PUR_VW_DTL
views.sql:
CREATE VIEW "PUR_VW_DTL" ("VTYPE","TRNID","TRNNO","TRNDATE","CMP_ID","CHCODE","NARRATION","DR","CR") AS 
SELECT PM.TRN_TYPE VTYPE,PM.TRNID,PM.TRNNO,PM.TRNDATE,PM.CMP_ID,DECODE(PM.TRN_TYPE,7,I.PUR_CODE,10,I.EXP_CODE) CHCODE,
       DECODE(PM.TRN_TYPE,7,'Purchase Invoice#',10,'Sale Return#')||PM.BILLNO||' '||DECODE(PM.DISCOUNT,'','','Discount'||' '||PM.DISCOUNT)NARRATION,
	     ROUND(SUM(NVL(PD.QTY *(PD.RATE-(PD.RATE/100*NVL(PD.DIS_PER,0))),0)))- NVL(PM.DISCOUNT,0) - NVL(PM.BREAKAGE,0) + NVL(PM.FREIGHT,0) DR,
	     0 CR
FROM   PMST PM, PDTL PD, PUR_ITEM I
WHERE  PM.TRNID = PD.TRNID
AND    PD.ICODE = I.ICODE
HAVING ROUND(SUM(NVL(PD.QTY *(PD.RATE-(PD.RATE/100*NVL(PD.DIS_PER,0))),0))) > 0
GROUP BY PM.TRNID,PM.TRNNO,PM.TRNDATE,PM.TRN_TYPE,PM.CMP_ID,I.PUR_CODE,I.EXP_CODE,PM.BILLNO,PM.DISCOUNT,PM.BREAKAGE,PM.FREIGHT
UNION ALL
SELECT PM.TRN_TYPE VTYPE,PM.TRNID,PM.TRNNO,PM.TRNDATE,PM.CMP_ID,DECODE(PM.P_TYPE,'R',PM.CHCODE,'C','04010001'),
       DECODE(PM.TRN_TYPE,7,'Purchase Invoice#',10,'Sale Return#')||PM.BILLNO||' '||DECODE(PM.DISCOUNT,'','','Discount'||' '||PM.DISCOUNT)NARRATION,
	     0 DR,
	     ROUND(SUM(NVL(PD.QTY *(PD.RATE-(PD.RATE/100*NVL(PD.DIS_PER,0))),0)))- NVL(PM.DISCOUNT,0) - NVL(PM.BREAKAGE,0) + NVL(PM.FREIGHT,0) CR

HAVING ROUND(SUM(NVL(PD.QTY *(PD.RATE-(PD.RATE/100*NVL(PD.DIS_PER,0))),0)))- NVL(PM.DISCOUNT,0) > 0
GROUP BY PM.TRNID,PM.TRNNO,PM.TRNDATE,PM.TRN_TYPE,PM.CMP_ID,PM.CHCODE,PM.P_TYPE,PM.DISCOUNT,PM.BILLNO,PM.BREAKAGE,PM.FREIGHT
UNION ALL

HAVING ROUND(SUM(NVL(BD.QTY *(BD.RATE-(BD.RATE/100*NVL(BD.DIS_PER,0))),0))) > 0
GROUP BY BM.TRNID,BM.TRNNO,BM.TRNDATE,BM.TRN_TYPE,BM.CMP_ID,I.PUR_CODE,BM.BILLNO,BM.DISCOUNT,BM.FREIGHT
UNION ALL

       'Purchase Return Invoice#'||BM.BILLNO||' '||DECODE(BM.DISCOUNT,'','','Discount'||' '||BM.DISCOUNT)NARRATION,

functions.sql:
CREATE FUNCTION GET_PUR_RATE (pCMP_ID NUMBER,pICODE VARCHAR2,pTRNDATE DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
v_RATE NUMBER;
BEGIN
  SELECT RATE  INTO v_RATE
  FROM
  (SELECT OP.CMP_ID,OP.OPEN_DATE TRNDATE,OP.TRNID VNO,OP.ICODE,NVL(OP.OPEN_RATE,0) RATE
  FROM  OPEN_STOCK OP,PUR_ITEM I
  WHERE OP.ICODE      = I.ICODE
  AND   OP.CMP_ID     = pCMP_ID
  AND   OP.OPEN_DATE <= pTRNDATE
  AND   OP.ICODE      = pICODE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT PM.CMP_ID,PM.TRNDATE,PD.VNO,PD.ICODE,NVL(PD.RATE,0)RATE
  FROM  PMST PM , PDTL PD, PUR_ITEM I
  WHERE PM.TRNID = PD.TRNID
  AND   PD.ICODE    = I.ICODE
  AND   PM.TRN_TYPE = 7
  AND   PM.CMP_ID   = pCMP_ID
  AND   PM.TRNDATE <= pTRNDATE
  AND   PD.ICODE    = pICODE
  ) A
  WHERE A.VNO =
  (
  SELECT MAX(B.VNO)
  FROM
  (SELECT OP.CMP_ID,OP.OPEN_DATE TRNDATE,OP.TRNID VNO,OP.ICODE
  FROM  OPEN_STOCK OP
  WHERE OP.CMP_ID     = pCMP_ID
  AND   OP.OPEN_DATE <= pTRNDATE
  AND   OP.ICODE      = pICODE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT PM.CMP_ID,PM.TRNDATE,PD.VNO,PD.ICODE
  FROM  PMST PM , PDTL PD
  WHERE PM.TRNID    = PD.TRNID
  AND   PM.TRN_TYPE = 7
  AND   PM.CMP_ID   = pCMP_ID
  AND   PM.TRNDATE <= pTRNDATE
  AND   PD.ICODE    = pICODE
  )B
  );
   RETURN v_RATE;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
  BEGIN
   SELECT RATE  INTO v_RATE
   FROM
   (
   SELECT PM.CMP_ID,PM.TRNDATE,PD.VNO,PD.ICODE,NVL(PD.RATE,0) RATE
   FROM  PMST PM , PDTL PD
   WHERE PM.TRNID    = PD.TRNID
   AND   PM.TRN_TYPE = 10
   AND   PM.CMP_ID   = pCMP_ID
   AND   PM.TRNDATE <= pTRNDATE
   AND   PD.ICODE    = pICODE
  ) A
  WHERE A.VNO =
  (
  SELECT MAX(B.VNO)
  FROM
  (
  SELECT PM.CMP_ID,PM.TRNDATE,PD.VNO
  FROM  PMST PM , PDTL PD
  WHERE PM.TRNID    = PD.TRNID
  AND   PM.TRN_TYPE = 10
  AND   PM.CMP_ID   = pCMP_ID
  AND   PM.TRNDATE <= pTRNDATE
  AND   PD.ICODE    = pICODE
  )B
  );
   RETURN v_RATE;
 EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
  RETURN 0;
 END;
END;
